name: hcs-ipfs-document-vault
description: Scaffold-HBAR template: HCS-anchored IPFS document vault

scripts.lint: npm run build -w @vault/ledger && npm run lint -w @vault/ledger && npm run lint -w @vault/hardhat && npm run lint -w @vault/nextjs
scripts.format: npm run format -w @vault/ledger && npm run format -w @vault/hardhat && npm run format -w @vault/nextjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vault/ledger && npm run test -w @vault/hardhat && npm run test -w @vault/nextjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vault/ledger && npm run compile -w @vault/hardhat && npm run build -w @vault/nextjs
